z-m-21-01.title: Gabagabada "hal oo keliya": ma runtii waa hal oo keliya?
z-m-21-01.topic: Qorista tibaax darajo-4 ah sidii wax-soo-saarka laba tibaax oo labajibbaaran: hubinta dhammaan xaaladaha suurtagalka ah
z-m-21-01.goal: Hubi gabagabada "hal oo keliya" ee la gaaray ka dib eegista qaar ka mid ah xaaladaha suurtagalka ah oo keliya, samee wax-soo-saarro kala duwan oo tibaaxo labajibbaaran ah oo isla tibaaxda darajo-4 ah si aad u xaqiijiso, oo sharax sababta tirada siyaabuhu u go'an tahay xataa marka shuruudaha la balaadhiyo.
z-m-21-01.material: Jiho wuxuu helay hab uu ku qoro x⁴−5x²+4 qaabka (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d). Halkan isugeynta x² waa 1 labada tibaax ee labajibbaaran, a, b, c, d waa tirooyin dhan, oo kala beddelidda kala horreynta labada tibaax ee labajibbaaran (tusaale, kala beddelidda a, b iyo c, d) waxay tirsamaan isku jibbaar-qaybin. Ka dib dhammaystirka xalka, Jiho wuxuu yiri, "Waxaa jira hal jibbaar-qaybin oo keliya oo sidaas ah." Hoos waa xalka Jiho. (Sida loo akhriyo: x⁴ waa "x awoodda afraad", x² waa "x labajibbaaran", ac-na waa "a jeer c".)
z-m-21-01.thinking.0: Helidda sadarka halka xaalad la seegay
z-m-21-01.thinking.1: Samaynta tusaalayaal kala duwan adigu oo jebiya gabagabada
z-m-21-01.thinking.2: Go'aaminta sida gabagabadu u isbeddesho marka shuruudda la beddelo (tirooyin dhan ilaa tirooyin dhab ah)
z-m-21-01.prereq.0: Balaadhinta wax-soo-saarka laba tibaax oo labajibbaaran iyo habaynta xubnaha isla darajada (heerka cutubka polynomial ee Xisaabta Guud, dugsiga dhexe fasalka 3aad ilaa dugsiga sare fasalka 1aad)
z-m-21-01.prereq.1: Macnaha laba polynomial inay yihiin isla tibaax x (isku-ekaansho). Meelaynta fasalka hawlgalkani waa qaybin adkaanta kooxda soo saarista oo keliya ma aha qoondayn fasal ee manhajka
z-m-21-01.prereq.2: Khibrad balaadhinta wax-soo-saarka tibaaxo toosan sida (x−1), (x+1)
z-m-21-01.s.s1.prompt: Sadarkee ayaa gabagabada Jiho "hal oo keliya" ka dhigaya mid adag in lagu rumaysto sida ay tahay? Dooro hal sadar.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.0: Calaamadee haddii sadar kasta uu si toos ah uga yimaado sadarka ka hor, iyo sadarka kee ayaa weedha "tani waa kan keliya" marka ugu horreysa ka muuqato.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sadar sida sadarka 4 ee samaynaya liis leh "waa mid ka mid ah ~", dib u samee liiska adigu shuruudda isku mid ah hoosteeda oo is barbar dhig mid mid liiska sadarka ku qoran.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.0: Balaadhi (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) oo waafaq isugeynta darajo kasta si ay u noqoto isla tibaaxda x⁴−5x²+4.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.1: Isugeynta x³, a+c=0, sidaas darteed c=−a, isugeynta x-na, ad+bc=a(d−b)=0, sidaas darteed a=0 ama b=d.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.3: b iyo d waa tirooyin dhan wax-soo-saarkooduna waa 4, sidaas darteed (b, d) waa mid ka mid ah (1, 4), (4, 1), (2, 2).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.4: Kuwaas dhexdooda, kan keliya ee buuxiya isugeynta x² b+d−a²=−5 waa b=d=2, a=3 (ama a=−3).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.5: Sidaas darteed, (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) waa jibbaar-qaybinta keliya ee sidaas ah.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.explain: Xisaabaha sadarrada 1 ilaa 3 waa sax (isugeynta x² waa b+d+ac, c=−a-na, waa b+d−a²). Sadarka 4 waa meesha marka ugu horreysa ay khaldanto. Lammaanayaasha tirooyinka dhan ee wax-soo-saarkoodu yahay 4 waxaa kale oo ku jira (−1, −4), (−4, −1), (−2, −2), laakiin lammaanayaasha togan oo keliya ayaa la qoray. Sadarka 5 waa sax "liiska la qoray dhexdiisa", laakiin liisku waa dhamaystiran yahay, sidaas darteed "hal oo keliya" ee sadarka 6 wuxuu u baahan yahay taageero. Xataa haddii aad dooratay sadarka 6, dhibku ma aha xisaabta sadarkaas lafteeda laakiin "haddii dhammaan xaaladaha hore la hubiyay".
z-m-21-01.s.s2.prompt: Samee laba jibbaar-qaybin oo kala duwan (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) oo le'eg x⁴−5x²+4. (a, b, c, d waa tirooyin dhan. Kuwa kala duwan oo kala horreyn oo keliya waxay tirsamaan isku jibbaar-qaybin.)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dib u samee liiska qiyamka b, d ee xalka Jiho adigu, oo sidoo kale ku beddel lammaanayaasha liiska ku jirin shuruudaha isugeynta hadhay si aad u hubiso.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.1: U kala qeybi laba laan, xaaladda a=0 iyo xaaladda b=d, oo hel qiyamka b iyo d mid kasta.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.ok.c0: a, b, c, d dhammaantood waa tirooyin dhan.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c0: Fadlan ka dhig a, b, c, d tirooyin dhan.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Isugeynta x³ (a+c) ka dib balaadhinta ma aha 0.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Isugeynta x² (b+d+ac) ka dib balaadhinta ma aha −5.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Isugeynta x (ad+bc) ka dib balaadhinta ma aha 0.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Joogtada (bd) ka dib balaadhinta ma aha 4.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.explain: Waxaa jira saddex jibbaar-qaybin oo tirooyin dhan oo suurtagal ah: (x²−1)(x²−4), (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2), iyo (x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Jibbaar-qaybinta Jiho waa mid keliya oo ka mid ah. Kuwa kala duwan oo kala horreyn oo keliya, sida kala beddelidda a iyo −a, waxaa loo tiriyay isku jibbaar-qaybin.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Haddii laba kooxeyn oo kala duwan labaduba samaystaan x⁴−5x²+4, halkee ayuu gabagabada Jiho "hal oo keliya" ku khaldamay? Qor laba ama saddex weedhood, adoo isticmaalaya ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah tibaaxaha aad hadda samaysay.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Balaadhi labada kooxeyn ee aad samaysay mid mid oo is barbar dhig haddii natiijooyinku yihiin isla tibaax.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Is barbar dhig sida Jiho u habeeyay xaaladaha suurtagalka ah iyo haddii kooxeynta aad samaysay ay liiskaas ku jiraan.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay adigu in tibaaxda aad bixisay runtii ay noqoto x⁴−5x²+4 marka la balaadhiyo?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma tilmaantay sababta khaladka sida "ka tagista xaaladaha suurtagalka ah" halkii "khalad xisaabeed"?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ma sidoo kale qortay waxa la sameeyo si loo yiraahdo "hal oo keliya"?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Balaadhinta (x²−1)(x²−4) waxay bixisaa x⁴−5x²+4, balaadhinta (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) na sidoo kale waxay bixisaa isla tibaax. Labada kooxeyn waa sax, sidaas darteed ma aha mid keliya. Jiho wuxuu ka tagay lammaanayaasha taban ee lammaanayaasha tirooyinka dhan ee wax-soo-saarkoodu yahay 4, sidaas darteed hal oo keliya ayaa hadhay.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Waxay sheegtaa labadaba tusaalaha lid ku ah (kooxeyn kale) iyo sababta (ka tagista xaaladaha)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.1: x⁴−5x²+4 waxaa lagu qori karaa (x−1)(x+1)(x−2)(x+2), sidaas darteed iyadoo ku xiran sida aad afarta tibaax ee toosan laba laba ugu kooxeyso, wax-soo-saarro badan oo tibaaxo labajibbaaran ah ayaa soo baxa, sida (x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Gabagabada Jiho waxay ka timid helidda hal hab oo keliya adoon hubin dhammaan xaaladaha.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Lagu sharaxay aragti kale, kooxeynta tibaaxaha toosan
z-m-21-01.s.s3.prompt: Hadda aan balaadhino shuruudda "isugeyn tirooyin dhan" una beddelno "isugeyn tirooyin dhab ah" (laba tibaax oo labajibbaaran oo isugeynta x² ay tahay 1; kuwa kala duwan oo kala horreyn oo keliya waa isku jibbaar-qaybin). Shuruudaha isugeynta ee kore, a+c=0, a(d−b)=0, b+d−a²=−5, bd=4, sida ay yihiin ayaa loo isticmaali karaa. Waa maxay hadalka ugu habboon ee ku saabsan tirada jibbaar-qaybinta suurtagalka ah xaaladan?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ka bilow a(d−b)=0, u kala qeybi xaaladda a=0 iyo xaaladda b=d, oo qor isla'egyada ka hadha mid walba.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.1: Laan kasta, si toos ah u xal oo tiri imisa qiimo ayay b iyo d qaadan karaan marka ay yihiin tirooyin dhab ah.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.a: Tirooyinka dhabta ah aad bay uga badan yihiin tirooyinka dhan, sidaas darteed waxaa jira qodobayn aan dhammaan
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.a: Fikirkani wuxuu arkaa in marka tirooyinka la ogolyahay ay badato, jawaabuhuna ay badan yihiin. Laakiin xaaladdan, maxaa dhici lahaa haddii marka hore laga fikiro sida shuruudaha isku-dhufashadu isugu xidhaan a, b, c, d?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.b: Weli waa saddex. Labada laan (marka a=0 iyo marka b=d), qiimayaasha horay ayaa loo go'aamiyay
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.b: Kani waa xukun u kala qaybiyay laba laan oo hubiyay haddii qiimayaasha lagu go'aamiyo tirooyinka dhabta ah dhexdooda sidoo kale.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.c: Wuu ka yaraadaa marka loo eego tirooyinka dhan. Tirooyinka dhabta ah waxay ka kooban yihiin tirooyinka dhan, sidaas darteed shuruudu way adag tahay
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad gabagabo ka soo qaadatay lid ku ah xaqiiqada ah "tirooyinka dhabta ah waxay ka kooban yihiin tirooyinka dhan." Marka baaxadda la ogolyahay ay ballaaranto, qodobaynta suurtagalka ahi ma yaraan karto. Hubi haddii saddexdii xaaladda tirooyinka dhan ay weli shaqeynayaan.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.d: Shuruudaha ma ku filna, sidaas darteed ma odhan karno imisa ayaa jira
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.d: Xukunkani wuxuu yidhi "macluumaad ma filna" adigoon tirinin haddii afartii isle'eg ee la bixiyay ay filan yihiin. Hubi haddii afar aan la aqoon iyo afar isle'eg ay soo koobaan qiimayaasha.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.explain: Maadaama a(d−b)=0, a=0 ama b=d. Haddii a=0, markaas b+d=−5 iyo bd=4, sidaas darteed b iyo d waa labada xidid −1 iyo −4 ee t²+5t+4=0 oo keliya. Haddii b=d, markaas b²=4 wuxuu siinayaa b=±2, iyo a²=2b+5, sidaas darteed marka b=2, a=±3, marka b=−2-na, a=±1. Xitaa tirooyinka dhabta ah dhexdooda wax laamahan ka baxsan ma jiraan, sidaas darteed iyadoo la iska indho tirayo kala horreynta weli waa saddex. Shuruudda ah in ay tahay tiro dhan ma ahayn mid miiraysa xaaladdan.
